modules.script:
def row_extender(data, id):
    import _school_default_row_extender
    default_row_extender(data, id)
    import _school_checkin
    get_std(data)
    lasting = 0
    # q2mess(data["I"])
    for tkey, tvalue in data["TABLA"].items():
        # q2mess(tvalue)
        if "ohne" in data["I"]:
            tvalue["price"] = tvalue["price1"]
        if not tvalue['code'].startswith('VS'):
            lasting +=num(tvalue["lasting"])
    data["TL"] = str(lasting)
    price_row = get("subjects", f" {lasting} <= lasting and code like 'ZP%' order by lasting limit 1")
    if "mit" in data["I"]:
        data["TS"] = price_row["price1"]
        data["KF"] = "☐️"
    else:
        data["TS"] = price_row["price"]
        data["KF"] = "☑️"
    tabla_index = len(data["TABLA"]) + 1
    data["TABLA"][f"{tabla_index }"] = {'subj': price_row["subj"],  'rprice': data["TS"], "name": price_row["name"], "date1": data["date1"]}
    data["TOTAL"] = str(num(data["TOTAL"]) + num(data["TS"]))
